Nested lists indented with 4 spaces per level

```ruby title="Ruby"

result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<ul><li>Outer<ul><li>Inner</li></ul></li></ul>', HtmlToMarkdownRs::ConversionOptions.new(list_indent_width: 4))
puts result.inspect
```
